content.title: Alloy Aluminum Ingot Production and Supply
content.description: Our alloy aluminum ingots are produced in accordance with Turkish and international standards and kept under control according to targeted chemical composition values. Samples taken after production are analyzed to verify alloy accuracy. Custom alloy designs can be developed according to customer needs; production planning is carried out based on mechanical strength, fluidity, and machinability criteria. Consistent and repeatable quality is achieved through a controlled casting process. Alloy options and chemical composition limits are listed in the table below. Please contact us for technical details and order requests.

content.title: Pure Aluminum Ingot Production and Supply
content.description: Our pure aluminum ingots are produced through a controlled process in line with targeted chemical purity values. After melting, samples are taken, composition analyses are verified, and the quality grade is checked. Throughout production, contamination control and composition stability are monitored as priorities. Suitable quality grades are supplied for applications requiring electrical conductivity and high purity. Chemical composition limits and quality grades are listed in the table below. Please contact us for technical information and order requests.

scrap-purchasing.description: We evaluate different types of aluminum scrap within recycling processes and return them to the industrial supply chain.

content.description: Kayalar Alüminyum accepts aluminum scrap from different sectors and includes it in a controlled recycling process. Scrap materials are classified according to type and structure; they are evaluated with metal recovery and process efficiency in mind. Industrial production waste, automotive-origin scrap, and various aluminum scrap groups are professionally processed and returned to the production chain.

content.title: KAYALAR ALÜMİNYUM
content.description: With years of experience in aluminum recycling and ingot production, we are shaping the future of the industry.

vision.title: Our Corporate Strength
vision.description:
Kayalar Alüminyum has been operating in aluminum recycling and ingot production with many years of experience.

Thanks to production processes carried out across multiple facilities, we provide solutions tailored to the needs of different sectors while combining a controlled production approach with a sustainable industrial perspective.
vision.quote: "We work with the principles of consistency in production, reliability in supply, and discipline in process management."

production.title: Our Production Approach
production.description: We manage our production processes through end-to-end controlled casting lines and our experienced technical team. We support our industrial strength with analysis discipline, process tracking, and a quality control approach.

corporate.title: Our Corporate Approach
corporate.description: Kayalar Alüminyum sees recycling and production processes not only as a commercial activity but also as part of a sustainable industrial approach. It strengthens its corporate structure through transparent business practices, a reliable supply approach, and long-term business partnerships.
